method.line_numbering: 1-based over the file split on newlines; blank lines and section markers count (verified on 9,080 flagged lines)

note: Counts only, no lyric text. clear phrases count wherever they appear (giveaway blocks still apply); loose phrases count only with a body/dance word within 5 tokens, no giveaway word near, on a line the reader flagged as sexual (or the same line repeated), in a song rated suggestive or stronger or objectifying. mentions = every counted occurrence, chorus repeats included. Loose counts are a floor: the reader flags evidence lines, not every line.

precision.design: 15 songs per tier drawn at random (seed 20260924), one counted match each; the owner opened each song and marked the match right or wrong

source: phrase count over the hash-locked lyric bodies, loose phrases gated by body/dance words nearby, giveaway words (config/body-phrases/blocked-by.txt) and card v3 sex.evidence lines
